resources.string: Catalog snapshot of expected APIs: %1$s · expected site access: %2$s. Click checks the current AMO package before installing.

Browse Mozilla\'s full Firefox for Android Add-ons catalog. On an add-on listing, tap “Install” or “Add to Firefox”; Click rechecks the public AMO record and current Android compatibility, then GeckoView validates the Mozilla signature and shows the permission/site-access review. Only official AMO downloads are accepted; local XPI, CRX and script installs are not supported.

The two cards above are quick picks; Browse opens Mozilla\'s full catalog. Click rechecks each selected add-on\'s live Android compatibility and official package. Updates are not automatic; remove an installed add-on before reinstalling it.

Public AMO listings and Mozilla signatures do not guarantee Google Play or AdSense approval. Click rechecks the public Android-compatible AMO package, then shows requested permissions and site patterns before Add; optional requests are prompted separately. Add-ons may read or change listed pages and process or send data under their own code and privacy terms. Native messaging, GeckoView add-on-install privileges and extension geolocation remain blocked. Chrome CRX, local packages, arbitrary scripts and userscripts are not supported.
